Ihre Vorteile:

- Limited for 24 month
- 40 hours per week

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Starting in the early stages of development, you will help develop designs for thermal and fluid-dynamic architectures of mechatronic and optical components, taking performance, timing, and cost into account.
- In this role, you will develop models and methods for system identification and control of thermal systems in microlithography equipment. 
- As a systems engineer, you will develop concepts and validate them using simulations (1D/3D), and define tests for design verification and model validation. 
- Your work will be carried out in close coordination with interdisciplinary teams consisting of internal and external developers, service providers, and suppliers 
- A key component of this role is the creation and coordination of requirements in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, as well as the preparation of development documents 
- As part of the industrialization process, another key responsibility is ensuring design verification, manufacturability, and integration capability, as well as risk management.
- Within a mechatronics team, you will represent the topics assigned to you in dealings with development projects and customers. This role is embedded in a development network consisting of customers, external partners in the high-tech industry, and research institutions.

Ihre Qualifikationen:

- An excellent university degree in aerospace engineering, mechatronics, cybernetics, process engineering, mechanical engineering, or physics, with professional experience in industry and academia 
- In-depth knowledge of the theory of numerical modeling, system identification, reduction, and control of thermal systems 
- Several years of experience in the thermal and thermoelastic design of components, as well as in the programming and application of CFD, FE, ANSYS, MATLAB, and Python. 
- An independent and systematic approach to work, as well as excellent organizational and communication skills 
- Enjoyment of working as part of an interdisciplinary team in a highly dynamic environment 
- Excellent skills in organizing, communicating, and presenting tasks and work results 
- Excellent written and spoken English skills

Our many years of recruitment experience and our expert knowledge of the engineering job market make us a strong partner for engineers and technicians. As Operations Coordinator, Fleet you will help provide our customers with an extraordinary product experience through our internal fleet of vehicles for showroom, events, test drives, mobile rangers, and other purposes. As part of the Central Europe Operations team, you will be responsible for running our fleet operations in the region (DACH and Eastern Europe) and work with our EMEA and local sales and service counterparts to help assign and organize fleet vehicles in the right locations. You will also be responsible for managing their lifecycle into our used car sales process.We offer:

- Career Development & Training: At Tesla, you have the opportunity for personal and professional growth through regular performance reviews, targeted training measures, and further education options (e.g. high-voltage training, management training).
- Company Culture: Immerse yourself in our inspiring company culture, where innovation, teamwork, and passion are at the center.
- Innovative Projects & Technologies: You have the chance to work on groundbreaking projects and technologies that help shape the future of the automotive industry and sustainable energy.
- Benefits & Additional Services: You can expect a competitive salary and benefits package that includes Tesla stock or a Cash Award, access to our Corporate Benefits program, 30 days of vacation, a 13th monthly salary, as well as the option of a company pension scheme and a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.
- Committed Team & Positive Working Atmosphere: Work in a dedicated and motivated team characterized by a great atmosphere and excellent teamwork. Be part of a team that contributes to a sustainable future and renewable energies.

What You’ll Do

- Fleet Organization: You organize and manage our internal fleet of test drive, showroom, loaner, mobile ranger, and other vehicles

About Us

GEB Technology Europe GmbH is a wholly-owned subsidiary of GEB Shandong Golden Empire Precision Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. GEB focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of precision mechanical components, with a core emphasis on precision stamping technology. The company primarily produces bearing cages, precision automotive components, drive components for electric vehicles, and components for hydrogen fuel cells. Awarded the titles of "National Manufacturing Single Champion Demonstration Enterprise" and "National High-Tech Enterprise," GEB possesses a national enterprise technology center and has accumulated extensive experience in R&D design and intelligent manufacturing. Guided by the corporate philosophy "Quality is Gold, Customer is King," the company drives product innovation and technological advancement to meet high-end market demands. GEB will continuously focus on industries such as new energy vehicles, wind power, and hydrogen energy. To strengthen our team in the Schweinfurt area, we are looking for a Commercial Assistant (m/f/d) to join us at the earliest opportunity for a part-time / Minijob position.

- Location & Permit: Currently based in Schweinfurt or the immediate surrounding region with a short commute. Must hold a valid German residence and work permit (e.g., Student Visa/Werkstudent, Family Reunion Visa, or permanent residency).
- Skills & Education: Academic background or initial practical knowledge in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related commercial field. Basic understanding of German accounting principles (HGB) is highly advantageous. Proficient in MS Excel.
- Attributes: High level of reliability, strong attention to detail, and absolute discretion when handling sensitive corporate financial data.

We are growing, and we are currently reshaping our whole range of activities.

What this role is about We are looking for someone to oversee, develop and be present across our whole range of activities – from workshops to events at our community café at Boxhagener Platz (jam sessions, music nights, exhibitions and more). The clear goal: turning individual activities into recurring small communities with their own memberships. Instead of activities we have to market and fill again every time, we want formats people come back to regularly – a knitting club, a sports format, creative combinations, a recurring music night. You drive this: you sense what the community wants, develop formats to match, test them, run them yourself, recruit and support the volunteers who help carry them, and make sure the good ones actually happen and grow.

What you'll do

- Oversee and support the offering. You keep an eye on all running activities – workshops and café events alike – are regularly present on site, and make sure everything runs smoothly, including the operational side in our booking tool (cancellations, refunds, correct details) – a small but important part of the week.
- Develop and test formats and events. - Experience running workshops, events, groups or community formats, at a quality others can build on.

- Conceptual strength: you can develop formats, test them, and judge honestly what works.
- Self-direction and ownership – you drive your area like a genuine project lead.
- Fixed on-site times: at least 3–4 evenings per week (around 2–3 hours each, within the 5–10 pm window) plus 1 day at the weekend (Saturday or Sunday, daytime or evening). These are your core working hours. The rest of your time you can arrange flexibly from the office. This on-site presence comes with a lot of creative freedom, but it is also a clear expectation.
- Comfortable with digital tools; German and English are a strong plus for our multilingual community.

What to expect from us

- A role with real room to shape things: you are building something that doesn't exist yet.
- A small, committed team and real closeness to a lively, international community.
- We set the strategic and financial direction (e.g. the membership model) as managing directors; you develop and decide on the formats independently, with our final sign-off.

Terms

- Start: September/October 2026 or by arrangement
- Pay: €2,400–2,800 gross/month (at 36 hrs)
